name: lines
description: Lines / payline mechanic: evaluates left-to-right matching along every payline in the active PaylineSet, looking up each matched run in the Paytable. This is a SANCTIONED C# FAST-PATH (invariant 11 / D25), not a hardcoded molecule (invariant 2): payline evaluation iterates paylines × positions — nested iteration that level-(b) expressions forbid (no nested folds, G9) — so it cannot be authored as a pure subgraph. The LinesEvaluator fast-path is proven equivalent to an independent canonical reference exhaustively (27 combos) and over 10,000+ PBT cases with auto-shrinking (FastPathEquivalenceTests). The 'board' port carries the flat state array (invariant 4 — there is no kernel Board type) to the per-game registered evaluator. Input port: 'board'. Output port: 'wins'.
